verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no auto-shutdown timer, idle-stop, or configurable spend limit for Vast.ai instances. The only billing-related items are prepaid credit top-ups and autobilling, which automatically refills the balance. That is the opposite of a spend cap. The docs only imply that instances may be interrupted or deleted when the balance runs out, which is an adjacent side effect, not a user-set limit.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can set auto-shutdown timers or spend limits so a forgotten instance can't silently run up a huge bill
